fields.name: media_footerVariant
fields.label: Footer layout
fields.description: A: photo/video background, columns right. B: Phase 3 gradient, button centred.

fields.name: media_backgroundMode
fields.label: Background type
fields.description: Image, Video (muted loop over the image), or both. Variant A only.

fields.name: media_backgroundImage
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: JPG, JPEG or PNG covering the footer. Variant A only; ignored in B.

fields.name: media_backgroundImageAlt
fields.label: Background image alt text
fields.description: Leave empty if decorative. Max 125 chars.

fields.name: media_backgroundVideo
fields.label: Background video
fields.description: MP4 or MOV from Assets, or its full URL. Variant A only; ignored in B.

fields.name: brand_logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: The white JSW MOTORS wordmark. SVG only.

fields.name: brand_copyright
fields.label: Copyright text
fields.description: Under the logo, e.g. © 2026 JSW Motors  Mumbai, India. Max 60 chars.

fields.name: brand_ctaButton
fields.label: CTA button link
fields.description: Where the white button leads: a page, or #section on one.

fields.name: brand_ctaButtonText
fields.label: CTA button text
fields.description: The "+" is added on the page. Max 24 chars.

fields.name: brand_privacyPolicyText
fields.label: Privacy policy text
fields.description: At the foot, on the left. Max 30 chars.

fields.name: brand_socialHeading
fields.label: Social heading
fields.description: Above the social icons, e.g. CONNECT. Max 20 chars.

fields.name: columnHeading
fields.label: Column title
fields.description: e.g. TECHNOLOGY. Max 20 chars.

fields.name: links_link1
fields.label: Link 1 URL
fields.description: Page, #section or full URL. Needs its text too, or it is hidden.

fields.name: links_link1Text
fields.label: Link 1 text
fields.description: e.g. NEVs, max 24 chars. Needs its URL too, or it is hidden.

fields.name: links_link2
fields.label: Link 2 URL
fields.description: Page, #section or full URL. Needs its text too, or it is hidden.

fields.name: links_link2Text
fields.label: Link 2 text
fields.description: e.g. NEVs, max 24 chars. Needs its URL too, or it is hidden.

fields.name: links_link3
fields.label: Link 3 URL
fields.description: Page, #section or full URL. Needs its text too, or it is hidden.

fields.name: links_link3Text
fields.label: Link 3 text
fields.description: e.g. NEVs, max 24 chars. Needs its URL too, or it is hidden.

fields.name: links_link4
fields.label: Link 4 URL
fields.description: Page, #section or full URL. Needs its text too, or it is hidden.

fields.name: links_link4Text
fields.label: Link 4 text
fields.description: e.g. NEVs, max 24 chars. Needs its URL too, or it is hidden.

fields.name: iconImage
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: White logo, SVG, PNG, JPG or JPEG. Max 4 icons shown; needs name and URL.

fields.name: iconImageAlt
fields.label: Network name
fields.description: e.g. Facebook: read by screen readers, the link text in Variant B. Max 30.

fields.name: iconLink
fields.label: URL
fields.description: The JSW Motors profile URL. Needs the icon and name too, or it is hidden.
